name: 徳川秀忠_バストアップ.png
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 512x512 in-game boss bust portrait for Sekigahara Ranbu.
Primary request: Draw one fierce, slightly-right-facing head-and-shoulders portrait of Tokugawa Hidetada, matching the attached character sheet exactly.
Subject: Preserve his mature stern face, tall paired gold horn crest, dark navy-and-gold armor, and deep blue cloak with gold Tokugawa motifs. Frame the complete crest, face, shoulders, and upper chest.
Style/medium: Painted anime-realistic Japanese action-game portrait, crisp dark outlines, rich lacquer and textile detail, dramatic restrained lighting.
Composition/framing: One person, centered bust, with clear magenta margin around the crest and shoulder silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: Exactly flat pure RGB(255,0,255) / #FF00FF.
Constraints: Keep identity, headwear, armor, and colors faithful to the reference. His weapon is a matchlock; leave it out if it would crowd this portrait.
Avoid: Text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, border, scenery, extra people, cropped crest or shoulders, gradients, background shadow, watermark.

automaticCheck.result: PASS for base UI bust portrait; bust crop intentionally fills canvas.
